postInstall: Open Unity Hub and add this folder as an existing project (Unity 6 LTS recommended).

Install recommended packages via Package Manager: com.unity.render-pipelines.universal, com.unity.inputsystem, com.unity.cinemachine, com.unity.2d.sprite, com.unity.2d.tilemap, com.unity.2d.animation, com.unity.2d.pixel-perfect, com.unity.test-framework.
Project Settings > Editor > Asset Serialization Mode = Force Text.
Create a Renderer2DData asset and assign it to the URP renderer list.
